name: Indicator Management & Enrichment
description: Collecting, validating, enriching, and managing indicators of compromise (IOCs) and other technical intelligence. Covers indicator lifecycle management, enrichment using threat intelligence platforms and open-source tools, confidence scoring, false positive assessment, and maintaining indicator quality for consumption by defensive tools.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to indicator management or IOC handling

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands what indicators of compromise are and their role in threat detection
evidence: Can describe common IOC types (IP, domain, hash, URL, email, certificate)
Understands the concept of indicator lifecycle and decay
Aware of the pyramid of pain and the relative difficulty of adversary evasion across indicator types

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Extracts and enriches indicators using standard tools under supervision
evidence: Extracts IOCs from reports, malware samples, and engagement artifacts under guidance
Enriches indicators using VirusTotal, Shodan, passive DNS, and similar services
Follows lab procedures for indicator documentation and tagging
Indicator quality reviewed by authorized analyst

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently manages indicator pipelines and produces enriched, scored indicator sets
evidence: Manages end-to-end indicator lifecycle across 3+ engagements
Assigns confidence scores based on source reliability and corroboration
Assesses indicators for false positive risk before dissemination
Produces indicator packages suitable for defensive tool ingestion that pass QA review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops indicator management automation; handles complex enrichment; mentors analysts
evidence: Develops automated indicator ingestion, enrichment, and scoring pipelines
Performs complex indicator pivoting to discover related infrastructure and campaigns
Maintains and curates threat intelligence platform indicator databases
Mentors junior analysts on indicator management tradecraft and quality standards

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines indicator management methodology; architects intelligence platform; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's indicator management methodology and platform architecture
Develops novel enrichment techniques and scoring models
Publishes research on indicator quality, lifecycle management, or enrichment methods
Trains teams on indicator management and defines quality standards

assessment_methods.description: Given a raw threat report, extract all indicators, enrich them using available tools, assign confidence scores, and produce a consumable indicator package
Audit indicator databases or packages for scoring accuracy, enrichment completeness, and false positive rates
